name: PAMAP2 → OPPORTUNITY-A
description: Train on PAMAP2 (12 activities, 3 body-worn IMUs, 27 channels) and evaluate on OPPORTUNITY Track A (17 gesture classes, body IMUs and object sensors, 79 channels). Only the locomotion classes shared between both datasets are evaluated: Stand, Walk, Sit, and Lie. This pair tests generalization from IMU-only to multimodal sensors, and from scripted activity sessions to naturalistic daily routines.

protocol.type: Train on source, test on target
protocol.source_train: PAMAP2 subjects 1–7 (LOSO folds, each used as source)
protocol.note: Use only body-worn IMU channels from OPPORTUNITY (skip object sensors if architecture does not support them). Use ADL run only. Report mean ± std across 4 LOSO folds.
